# Team Topologies

By Skelton and Pais.

Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do. I read it on the train over two weeks, a chapter a day. Favourite idea: write things down before you trust your memory.

A good book for a long flight. I would give it four stars out of five. It changed how I run the weekly review.

Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning. Liam recommended it after our conversation about focus. The main argument is that small habits compound over years.
